requirements.text: In the case of all other signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction, the reference axis of the lamp shall be allowed a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp shall comply with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: Where an AFS is installed, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the AFS in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: When a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, is installed, the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: As an alternative, when a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, is installed, the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these lamps and apparent surfaces shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: When the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The white light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, their electrical connections shall be such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
requirements.quote: Their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5.
requirements.quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements in paragraph 5.12.1.2. shall be provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
requirements.quote: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp

requirements.text: The main-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Main-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Dipped-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall emit white or selective yellow light.
requirements.quote: Front fog lamp: White or selective yellow

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Hazard warning signal: Amber

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall emit amber or red light.
requirements.quote: Emergency stop signal : Amber or red

requirements.text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Rear-end collision alert signal: Amber

requirements.text: The rear registration plate lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Rear registration plate lamp: White

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Front position lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear fog lamp: Red

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall emit white light in front, red at the rear, and amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: Parking lamp: White in front, red at the rear, amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Side-marker lamp: Amber

requirements.text: When the rearmost side-marker lamp is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or has part of its light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector, the rearmost side-marker lamp may emit red light.
requirements.quote: however the rearmost side- marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall emit white light in front and red light at the rear.
requirements.quote: End-outline marker lamp: White in front, red at the rear

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Daytime running lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, triangular: Red

requirements.text: The front retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be identical to incident light.
requirements.quote: Front retro-reflector, non- triangular: Identical to incident light8

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Side retro-reflector, non- triangular: Amber

requirements.text: When the rearmost side retro-reflector is grouped or has part of its light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, the rearmost side retro-reflector may emit red light.
requirements.quote: however the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp

requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Cornering lamp: White

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit white light to the front.
requirements.quote: Conspicuity marking: White to the front

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit white or yellow light to the side.
requirements.quote: White or yellow to the side

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit red or yellow light to the rear.
requirements.quote: Red or yellow to the rear

requirements.text: The adaptive front-lighting system (AFS) shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS): White

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: White

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp shall meet the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: In addition, in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp

requirements.text: The manoeuvring lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Manoeuvring lamp: White

requirements.text: The answer-back signal shall meet the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
requirements.quote: Answer-back signal: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal

requirements.text: The reversing projection shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing projection: White

requirements.text: The lamp may be installed on movable components only if the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: If the 0.15 per cent value is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent requirement in paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the lamps indicated in paragraph 5.21. shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent requirement in paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent requirement in paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: The temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate

requirements.text: The replacement device of a rear position lamp shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function

requirements.text: During replacement of a rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions.
requirements.quote: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 6 Volt-Systems the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems)

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 12 Volt-Systems the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems)

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 24 Volt-Systems the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent

requirements.text: The inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the lamp shall have no obstacle to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved shall not be taken into account.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: All lamps shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be number two, Class “F3”.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the front fog lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: When the vehicle is of category M1 or N1, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Maximum: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: not more than 800 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicle other than M1, N1 and N3G (off-road) vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For all other categories except N3G (off-road) vehicles: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For category N3G vehicles, the maximum height of the front fog lamp may be increased to 1,500 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For category N3G vehicles: the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface of the front fog lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be located at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the front fog lamp shall not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the front fog lamp shall be defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.quote: Geometric visibility Defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The angle α of the geometric visibility of the front fog lamp shall be 5° upwards and downwards.
requirements.quote: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The angle ß of the geometric visibility of the front fog lamp shall be 45° outwards and 10° inwards.
requirements.quote: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be oriented toward the front.
requirements.quote: Orientation Toward the front.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be –1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall, under all the static conditions of Annex 5 and for a mounting height h of 0.8 metres or less, automatically remain between –1.0 per cent and –3.0 per cent for limits.
requirements.quote: Depending on the mounting height in metres (h) of the lower edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp, measured on the unladen vehicles, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between the following values: h ≤ 0.8 Limits: between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall, under all the static conditions of Annex 5 and for a mounting height h of 0.8 metres or less, automatically remain between –1.5 per cent and –2.0 per cent for initial aiming.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall, under all the static conditions of Annex 5 and for a mounting height h greater than 0.8 metres, automatically remain between –1.5 per cent and –3.5 per cent for limits.
requirements.quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall, under all the static conditions of Annex 5 and for a mounting height h greater than 0.8 metres, automatically remain between –2.0 per cent and –2.5 per cent for initial aiming.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the value of the indicated downward inclination of the cut-off shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed shall apply.

requirements.text: If applicable, the light source module(s) shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.

requirements.text: In the case where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, in case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.

requirements.quote: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.

requirements.quote: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.

requirements.quote: Except for cornering lamps, complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.

requirements.quote: If required by the provisions of the relevant UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86 the device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation (see definition of “light source” in UN Regulation No. 48) wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options.
requirements.quote: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation (see definition of “light source” in UN Regulation No. 48) wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options:

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (a) One or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval.
requirements.quote: (b) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs.
requirements.quote: (c) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where more than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.
requirements.quote: (d) More than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.

requirements.text: In case more than one light source is used, the option (d) provision shall apply to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.
requirements.quote: In case more than one light source is used, this provision applies to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.

requirements.text: Where fitted, a signal indicating the failure of a specific function realised with more than one element for visible radiation shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, when one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (e) If fitted, one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.

requirements.text: When a replaceable light source is assembled, the component(s) to which it is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily.
requirements.quote: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily

requirements.text: When a replaceable light source is assembled, the component(s) to which it is assembled shall be so made that, even in darkness, the light source can be fitted in no position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source.
requirements.quote: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source, which may be submitted with the lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps, except that for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
requirements.quote: Colour of light emitted: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps. However, for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.

requirements.text: The passing-beam shall meet the luminous intensities at the test points referred to in Table 6 and in Figure A4-V.
requirements.quote: The passing-beam shall meet the luminous intensities at the test points referred to in Table 6 and in Figure A4-V.

requirements.text: The adaptive front-lighting system shall be so made that, when signal inputs according to paragraph 5.3.1.4.2. apply, the requirements of paragraph 5.3.2. shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Other modes: When signal inputs according to paragraph 5.3.1.4.2. apply, the requirements of the paragraph 5.3.2. shall be fulfilled.

requirements.text: For Class AS headlamps (Figure A4-VII in Annex 4), the passing-beam shall meet the requirements in Table 14.
requirements.quote: For Class AS headlamps (Figure A4-VII in Annex 4) Table 14 Type approval photometric requirements for Class AS passing-beam

requirements.quote: For Classes CS and DS headlamps (Figure A4-IX in Annex 4) Table 16 Type approval photometric requirements for Class CS and Class DS passing-beam

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
requirements.quote: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.

requirements.text: When vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line.
requirements.quote: If, however, vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line

requirements.text: When vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to perform the beam vertical adjustment.
requirements.quote: and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall meet the type approval photometric requirements in Table 17.
requirements.quote: Photometric requirements Table 17 Type approval photometric requirements for front fog lamp

requirements.text: The luminous intensity shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall not exhibit variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R.
requirements.quote: Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.

requirements.text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern shall be substantially uniform.
requirements.quote: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern should be substantially uniform.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall not exhibit discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9.
requirements.quote: Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.

requirements.text: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 are allowed with not more than 1.75∙10² cd, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.quote: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 1.75∙10² cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.

requirements.text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
requirements.quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp function system may automatically vary the luminous intensities to adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, only if an active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system.
requirements.quote: it is permitted to automatically vary the luminous intensities provided that: (a) An active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system

requirements.text: When the front fog lamp function system automatically varies the luminous intensities, all intensities shall be varied proportionately.
requirements.quote: (b) All intensities are varied proportionately.

requirements.text: When checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., the front fog lamp function system shall be considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.
requirements.quote: The system, when checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.

requirements.text: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the front fog lamp function system provides automatic modifications, such that good road illumination is achieved.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the system provides automatic modifications, such that good road illumination is achieved

requirements.text: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the front fog lamp function system provides automatic modifications, such that no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.
requirements.quote: and no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.

requirements.text: The photometric measurements of the front fog lamp shall be performed according to the applicant's description.
requirements.quote: Photometric measurements shall be performed according to the applicant's description.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, the conformity of production photometric requirements in Table 19 shall apply.
requirements.quote: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, Table 19 shall apply

requirements.text: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 are allowed with not more than 2.10∙10² cd, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.quote: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 2.10∙10² cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.

requirements.text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
requirements.quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.

requirements.text: The alignment of the front fog lamp may be changed according to the provisions in Annex 5, paragraph 4.1, only if the results of the test described above do not meet the requirements.
requirements.quote: If the results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, the alignment of the front fog lamp may be changed according to the provisions in Annex 5, paragraph. 4.1.

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, one of the sampled lamps or systems shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7.
requirements.quote: One of the sampled lamps or systems shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, the headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if "Δr" does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: A headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, the headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if "Δr" does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: A headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second sample shall be subjected to the test.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second sample shall be subjected to the test

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, another two systems shall be subjected to the same procedure.
requirements.quote: if this value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, another two systems shall be subjected to the same procedure

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the other two systems shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: the value of ∆r for each of them shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the other two systems shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: the value of ∆r for each of them shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if Δr does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: A front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: When the value of Δr of the front fog lamp exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test

requirements.text: When the value of Δr of the front fog lamp exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both front fog lamps shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: after which the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.quote: For front fog lamps according to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, to the points 8 and 9, and the lines 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9 as specified in Table 19.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II) as follows.
requirements.quote: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II) as follows.

requirements.quote: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.quote: The measuring distance at which the test was carried out shall be recorded in item 9. of the communication form (see Annex 1 to this Regulation).

requirements.text: For passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric "cut-off" line, the value of G shall not be less than 0.13 (minimum sharpness).

requirements.text: For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line, the value of G shall not be less than 0.08 (minimum sharpness).

requirements.quote: and not greater than 0.40 (maximum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric "cut-off" line.

requirements.quote: (a) For passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric "cut-off" line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" that serves for vertical adjustment shall be horizontal between 1.5° and 3.5° from the V-V line (see Figure A6-I).

requirements.quote: (b) For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).

requirements.quote: The inflection points of the "cut-off" gradient at the vertical lines at 1.5°, 2.5° and 3.5° shall be determined by the equation: (d2 (log E) / dβ2 = 0).

requirements.text: For passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric "cut-off" line, the maximum vertical distance between the inflection points shall not exceed 0.2°.
requirements.quote: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed: (a) 0.2° for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric "cut-off" line

requirements.text: For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line, the maximum vertical distance between the inflection points shall not exceed 0.5°.
requirements.quote: or (b) 0.5° for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line

requirements.text: When the "cut-off" complies with the quality requirements of paragraph 2.2., the vertical scan for a front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line shall be carried out on the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.quote: (b) on the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line (see Figure A6-II)

requirements.text: The inflection point of a front fog lamp shall be determined and positioned on the line B situated 1° below H-H line.
requirements.quote: (b) 1° below H-H line for front fog lamp

requirements.text: The cut-off line of a passing-beam headlamp or front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: The cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant.
requirements.quote: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall otherwise be aligned in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam or AFS, Imax for driving-beam shall be tested.
requirements.quote: (a) In the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam or AFS: Imax for driving-beam

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam or AFS, the points 40L, 50R and B50L for passing-beam (or 40R, 50L and B50R for headlamps designed for left-hand traffic) shall be tested.
requirements.quote: and in points 40L, 50R, B50L for passing-beam (or 40R, 50L, B50R for headlamps designed for left-hand traffic)

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, in the case of a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam, Imax for driving-beam and the points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R, 50R and 50L for Class BS passing-beam shall be tested.
requirements.quote: (b) In the case of a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam: Imax for driving-beam and in points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R, 50R, 50L for Class BS passing-beam and in points 0.86°D- 3.5°R, 0.86°D-3.5°L, for Classes CS and DS passing-beams

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, in the case of front fog lamps, the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and the point HV shall be tested.
requirements.quote: (c) In the case of front fog lamps: at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV

requirements.text: A complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.
requirements.quote: A complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam pattern, the Class BS headlamp photometric values shall be verified in the points 50R, 50L, 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R for passing-beam and Imax for driving-beam.
requirements.quote: (a) Class BS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 50R - 50L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R. - Driving-beam: Imax

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam pattern, the Classes CS and DS headlamp photometric values shall be verified in the points 0.86°D/3.5°R, 0.86°D/3.5°L, 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R for passing-beam and Imax for driving-beam.
requirements.quote: (b) For Classes CS and DS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 0.86°D/3.5°R - 0.86°D/3.5°L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R. - Driving-beam: Imax

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, the value measured at points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 2.55∙10² cd.
requirements.quote: The value measured at points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 2.55∙102 cd.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, the photometric values shall be verified on point HV and Imax in zone D.
requirements.quote: In the case of front fog lamps on point HV and Imax in zone D.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, a 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test shall not be exceeded, including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.quote: A 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test is permissible including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.

requirements.text: The vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam.
requirements.quote: This test consists of verifying that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam, for front fog lamps, or in the case of an AFS for a system or part(s) of emitting a class C (basic) passing-beam, or each specified passing-beam mode.

requirements.text: The vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value for front fog lamps.
requirements.quote: This test consists of verifying that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam, for front fog lamps, or in the case of an AFS for a system or part(s) of emitting a class C (basic) passing-beam, or each specified passing-beam mode.

requirements.text: In the case of an AFS, the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value for a system or part(s) emitting a class C (basic) passing-beam, or for each specified passing-beam mode.
requirements.quote: This test consists of verifying that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam, for front fog lamps, or in the case of an AFS for a system or part(s) of emitting a class C (basic) passing-beam, or each specified passing-beam mode.

requirements.text: The device tested in accordance with paragraph 2. shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.1., without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
requirements.quote: The device tested in accordance with paragraph 2., shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.1., without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.

requirements.text: If the AFS consists of more than one lighting unit or more than one assembly of lighting units which provide a cut-off, each of these units or assemblies shall be tested separately as a test sample for this test.
requirements.quote: If the AFS consists of more than one lighting unit or more than one assembly of lighting units which provide a cut-off, each of these is understood to be a test sample for the purpose of this test and must be tested separately.

requirements.text: If the AFS has a moving optical part, only the position closest to the average vertical angular stroke and/or the initial position according to the neutral state shall be chosen for this test.
requirements.quote: If the AFS has a moving optical part, only the position closest to the average vertical angular stroke and/or the initial position according to the neutral state is chosen for this test.

requirements.text: The test shall be confined to signal input conditions corresponding to a straight road, only.
requirements.quote: The test is confined to signal input conditions corresponding to a straight road, only.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) after operation.
requirements.quote: In the case of a front fog lamps: the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified 60 minutes (r60) after operation.
requirements.quote: In the case of a front fog lamps: the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.

requirements.text: The measurement of the variation in the cut-off line position shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.
requirements.quote: The measurement of the variation in the cut-off line position as described above shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.

requirements.text: The absolute value Δr1 = | r3 - r60 |, expressed in milliradians (mrad), recorded on a headlamp or AFS shall be not more than 1.0 mrad upward (Δr1 ≤ 1.0 mrad).
requirements.quote: (a) In case of headlamps or AFS, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on the device is not more than 1.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 1.0 mrad) upward

requirements.text: The absolute value Δr1 = | r3 - r60 |, expressed in milliradians (mrad), recorded on a headlamp or AFS shall be not more than 2.0 mrad downwards (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).
requirements.quote: and not more than 2.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 2.0 mrad) downwards.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, the absolute value Δr1 = | r3 - r60 |, expressed in milliradians (mrad), recorded on the front fog lamp shall be not more than 2.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).
requirements.quote: (b) In case of front fog lamps, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on this device is not more than 2.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).

requirements.text: If the result does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in this paragraph.
requirements.quote: However, if the result does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle as described below, in order to stabilise the position of the mechanical parts of the device:

requirements.text: After the three cycles, the further sample shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.
requirements.quote: After these three cycles, the device shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on this further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.

requirements.text: The outer face of three samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C before immersion.
requirements.quote: The outer face of three samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C and then immersed for five minutes

requirements.quote: and then immersed for five minutes in a mixture maintained at 23 °C ± 5 °C and composed of 99 parts distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent impurities and one part alkylaryl sulphonate.

requirements.text: At the end of the test, the samples shall be dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: At the end of the test, the samples shall be dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: The surface of the samples shall be cleaned with a moist cloth.
requirements.quote: The surface of the samples shall be cleaned with a moist cloth.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12.
requirements.quote: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12;

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps.

requirements.quote: (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant

requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;

requirements.text: Except for lamps with non-replaceable light sources, where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall bear a marking indicating also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);

requirements.text: Where the lamp has an electronic light source control gear, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: Where the lamp has a variable luminous intensity control, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (b) A variable luminous intensity control;

requirements.text: Where the lamp has a secondary operating mode, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (c) A secondary operating mode;

requirements.text: Where the lamp has non-replaceable light sources, the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (d) Non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.quote: On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;

requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters MD for MODULE followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.

requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.quote: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (ii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.quote: If a front position lamp incorporates one or more infrared radiation generators, the photometric and colour requirements for this front position lamp shall be met with and without the operation of the infrared radiation generator(s).

requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps, instead of the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.2. and in addition to the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.1., in case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply.
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:

requirements.quote: (a) The light intensity at the points of standard light distribution defined in paragraph 2.2. of Annex 3 shall be at least 80 per cent of the minimum intensity required; or

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps, in case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.19.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.quote: (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.19.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.

requirements.quote: In this case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.

requirements.quote: (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed shall apply.
requirements.quote: The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: Where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) shall apply.
requirements.quote: In addition, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.

requirements.text: The light signalling devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;
